title: A real light theme
summary: Light mode now has its own frosted-white look with dark text, instead of the dark design on a washed-out background.

changes.text: Light mode text, buttons, cards and modals are easy to read again: dark text on frosted white glass with cyan accents.
Rarity colours, badges and status text switch to deeper shades in light mode so they stay visible.
The theme button always switches to the other theme on the first click, including when following your system setting.
